title: SkillGraph Metadata
description: Graph metadata block embedded in every skill definition. Drives composition, adaptation, routing, and connection upsells at runtime.

domains.description: Broad health domains like sleep, recovery, nutrition, longevity

device_affinities.description: Devices that improve this skill. Used to render richer output when connected, and to surface connection upsells when absent.

activity_affinities.description: Activities like cycling, running, strength training. Skill activates or deepens when user logs or connects these activities.

biomarker_affinities.description: Biomarkers especially relevant to this skill. Skill interprets these values if available in the user's lab history.

goals.description: Outcomes this skill addresses. Used to match skills to user goal profiles.

actions_enabled.description: What the skill can route into via MCP tools. Every skill must have at least one action.

connection_upsell.description: Data sources that, if connected, would meaningfully improve this skill's output. Surfaced as contextual prompts when missing.

complements.description: Other skill IDs frequently paired with this one. Drives the combination engine.

persona_compatible.description: Persona overlay IDs that fit this skill's domain and evidence style.

evidence_bundles.description: Reusable evidence pack IDs the skill can cite. Bundles live separately and are shared across skills.

listings_hooks.description: How this skill connects into product listings, venues, or services. Drives the Products & Shopping and Gyms categories.

venue_affinities.description: Venue and brand contexts this skill is relevant in (e.g. Barry's, Equinox, Life Time, HYROX).

icp_affinities.description: ICP labels from the contact/coach layer. Used when a Betterness One coach is serving a specific client segment.

user_segments.description: User identity labels. Used for cold-start recommendation before full goal profile is built.
